in_marathi.name: Dharmaraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharmaraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘dharma’ meaning righteousness and ‘raja’ meaning king or ruler. This name signifies a righteous ruler or one who upholds the principles of truth and justice.
